name: 会话归档
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="4" rx="1"/><path d="M5 8v11a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V8"/><path d="M9.5 12.5h5"/></svg>
description: 左栏会话行里的归档按钮：点一下把对话从侧边栏收起来（不删文件、不打断），可设 1/7/30 天或永不到期，到期自动删除对应会话文件。附归档管理面板，可恢复、改期、立即清理。
descriptionEn: An archive button inside each sidebar conversation row: tuck a chat away without deleting it, pick a 1/7/30-day or never expiry, and let the plugin delete the underlying session file when it expires. Ships a management panel to restore, re-schedule or purge archived chats.
